svg.aria-label: Enterprise GitOps delivery pipeline. CI: commit, Gitleaks secret scan, unit tests, SonarQube quality gate, Trivy dependency scan and SBOM, Terraform and Kyverno policy as code, Docker build. Release: Trivy image scan, cosign signing and push to Docker Hub, ECR or ACR, config repo bumped to the image digest, Argo CD pull-based sync, Kyverno admission, Argo Rollouts canary, production on AKS, EKS, GKE or DOKS. Verify: Prometheus, Loki and Tempo feed an SLO analysis that promotes the release or rolls it back automatically, pages PagerDuty and reverts the config repo.

svg.text: shift-left security · immutable digests · pull-based deploys · self-healing

text.tspan: every pull request is gated before it can merge
Git is the source of truth; the cluster pulls, nothing pushes in

svg.text: Terraform modules · Helm · one Argo CD
no kubectl from CI · no long-lived cloud keys (OIDC)
